```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(fs)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
source(here("case_studies", "src", "R", "visualize.R"))
source(here("case_studies", "src", "R", "error_rate_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
base <- path(here("case_studies", "sweep_tabular"))
cfg <- read_yaml(base / "config.yaml")

evaluation_dir <- base / "results" / "evaluation"
fig_dir <- base / cfg$figures_dir
dir_create(fig_dir)
theme_set(theme_axiomatic(base_size = 12))
ev <- load_evaluation(evaluation_dir)
```


```{r minshap-scores-d1}
p <- list()
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
    for (method in c("minshap", "sage", "permutation")) {
        p[[i]] <- feature_score_panel(ev$scores, glue("D{i}"), which_method=method)
    }
}

p
```
